== Underlord ==

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Advancement is activated by a true, deep understanding of oneself that causes [[soulfire]] to resonate with the surrounding aura.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5">''Underlord'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Advancement can trigger a transformation that lasts two or three weeks if done in weak aura with few [[natural treasures]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15">''Underlord'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Advancement can extend a person's lifespan.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15" />}}</li>
</ul></div>
